thread.title: Rep. Jeff Crank honors Medal of Honor recipients and highlights Colorado's defense industry
thread.title_full: Rep. Jeff Crank honors Medal of Honor recipients and highlights Colorado's defense industry

author: k. g. jensen
title: Rep. Jeff Crank honors Medal of Honor recipients and highlights Colorado's defense industry
text:
Rep. Jeff Crank marked National Medal of Honor Day with a series of posts on March 25, 2026, reflecting on military service and Colorado’s role in national defense.
In his first post, Rep. Crank stated, “On National Medal of Honor Day, we honor all our heroes who took up the call of duty with selfless action in service to our great nation.” This message was published on March 25, 2026.
Later that day, he discussed Colorado’s involvement in supporting the U.S. submarine fleet. On March 25, 2026, he wrote, “Had the opportunity to meet with the Submarine Industrial Base Council, where Colorado plays a pivotal role in directly supplying materials and manpower to our U.S. submarine fleet, to discuss strengthening our defense manufacturing capabilities and supporting the skilled” .
In a third post dated March 25, 2026, Rep. Crank honored Staff Sergeant Benjamin Pennington: “Staff Sergeant Benjamin Pennington was a true American hero who loved his country, ultimately giving his life to protect our nation’s freedoms. I was honored to speak with his father the other day to recall the many fond memories his son left behind.”
National Medal of Honor Day is observed annually in the United States on March 25 to recognize recipients of the nation’s highest military decoration for valor. The Submarine Industrial Base Council represents stakeholders involved in building and maintaining submarines for the U.S. Navy; Colorado is noted for its contributions through manufacturing and skilled labor within this sector.
